generationPrompts: Use case: logo-brand. New production raster logo for Al Hiba Used Cars. Single isolated compact AH monogram in solid light silver #c7d4dc, on genuinely transparent background. Very clean geometric A and H letters joined with a single strong sweeping horizontal bridge suggesting a road. The A is a clear triangular letter at the left with a large transparent triangular counter; the H is a vertical post at the right and an upper short post at center. Simple smooth hard boundaries and large negative spaces; professionally constructed bold logo readable at32px. Use exactly one flat light silver ink for the entire mark. No navy, no black, no white, no outline, no tiny dashed road details. No texture, gradient, shadows, distress, mottling, speckled alpha, background, badges, mockups or additional text. Square canvas with balanced padding. The logo must be a polished clean asset, not a sketch.

Produce the matching dark-ink surface version of this AH monogram. Preserve this exact simple AH letter geometry, smooth sweeping bridge, spacing and transparent knockout areas. Re-render all visible ink as flat solid very dark navy #10232b. Remove tiny detached specks so empty spaces are entirely transparent. The artwork must have clean crisp graphic edges, no texture, no shading, no new forms, no text and no background. True transparent background. It must remain a faithful variant of this same AH monogram.
